author: Mousku
quote: Tried it for the first time in 2026 after hearing it’s the ”greatest game of all time”. This is straight up garbage. Maybe it was cool 30 years ago but it’s trash today.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Mousku
quote: Waited 30 years and all they could do is the same game with prettier graphics. Even the voice acting is terrible. Game was good back in the days but is laughably bad in 2026
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Mousku
quote:
There’s so much to say but I’ll keep it short.

Game simply blows my mind. Most fun I’ve had in a videogame in a long time.
